mapper.update: create table if not exists dy_rpa_shop_config ( shop_config_id bigint not null auto_increment, shop_code varchar(64) not null, shop_name varchar(100) not null, douyin_account_code varchar(128) not null, douyin_shop_name varchar(128) not null, message_template varchar(1000) default null, daily_limit int not null default 200, status char(1) not null default '0', remark varchar(500) default null, create_time datetime default null, update_time datetime default null, primary key (shop_config_id), unique key uk_dy_rpa_shop_code (shop_code), key idx_dy_rpa_shop_status (status) ) engine=InnoDB default charset=utf8mb4 comment='RPA shop and Douyin account configuration'

create table if not exists dy_rpa_room_shop ( room_key varchar(128) not null, shop_config_id bigint not null, create_time datetime default null, update_time datetime default null, primary key (room_key), key idx_dy_rpa_room_shop (shop_config_id) ) engine=InnoDB default charset=utf8mb4 comment='Live room to RPA shop mapping'

create table if not exists dy_rpa_outreach_task ( task_id bigint not null auto_increment, task_no varchar(64) not null, viewer_id bigint not null, lead_id bigint not null, shop_config_id bigint not null, sec_uid varchar(256) not null, profile_url varchar(500) not null, status varchar(32) not null default 'pending', priority int not null default 0, attempt_count int not null default 0, max_attempts int not null default 5, batch_no varchar(64) default null, lease_token varchar(64) default null, worker_id varchar(128) default null, lease_expire_time datetime default null, result_request_id varchar(64) default null, outcome varchar(32) default null, douyin_no varchar(128) default null, order_no varchar(128) default null, followed tinyint not null default 0, messaged tinyint not null default 0, message_content varchar(1000) default null, result_code varchar(64) default null, error_message varchar(1000) default null, first_claim_time datetime default null, completed_time datetime default null, create_time datetime default null, update_time datetime default null, primary key (task_id), unique key uk_dy_rpa_task_no (task_no), unique key uk_dy_rpa_shop_viewer (shop_config_id, viewer_id), unique key uk_dy_rpa_result_request (result_request_id), key idx_dy_rpa_task_claim (status, shop_config_id, priority, task_id), key idx_dy_rpa_task_batch (batch_no), key idx_dy_rpa_task_lease (lease_expire_time) ) engine=InnoDB default charset=utf8mb4 comment='RPA outreach task queue'

create table if not exists dy_rpa_outreach_batch ( batch_id bigint not null auto_increment, batch_no varchar(64) not null, shop_config_id bigint not null, active_shop_key varchar(64) default null, worker_id varchar(128) not null, lease_token varchar(64) not null, status varchar(32) not null default 'leased', task_count int not null default 0, completed_count int not null default 0, lease_expire_time datetime not null, create_time datetime default null, update_time datetime default null, completed_time datetime default null, primary key (batch_id), unique key uk_dy_rpa_batch_no (batch_no), unique key uk_dy_rpa_active_shop (active_shop_key), key idx_dy_rpa_batch_worker (worker_id, status), key idx_dy_rpa_batch_lease (lease_expire_time) ) engine=InnoDB default charset=utf8mb4 comment='RPA outreach leased batches'
alter table dy_rpa_room_shop modify column room_key varchar(128) not null
alter table dy_rpa_outreach_task modify column sec_uid varchar(256) not null

update dy_rpa_outreach_task set status = if(attempt_count >= max_attempts, 'failed', 'pending'), lease_token = null, worker_id = null, lease_expire_time = null, result_code = if(attempt_count >= max_attempts, 'LEASE_EXHAUSTED', result_code), error_message = if(attempt_count >= max_attempts, '任务租约多次过期', error_message), completed_time = if(attempt_count >= max_attempts, sysdate(), null), update_time = sysdate() where status = 'leased' and lease_expire_time < sysdate()
update dy_rpa_outreach_batch set status = 'expired', active_shop_key = null, completed_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where status = 'leased' and lease_expire_time < sysdate()
mapper.insert: insert ignore into dy_rpa_outreach_task( task_no, viewer_id, lead_id, shop_config_id, sec_uid, profile_url, status, priority, attempt_count, max_attempts, create_time, update_time ) select replace(uuid(), '-', ''), ranked.viewer_id, ranked.lead_id, ranked.shop_config_id, ranked.sec_uid, concat('https://www.douyin.com/user/', ranked.sec_uid), 'pending', ranked.priority, 0, 5, sysdate(), sysdate() from ( select l.viewer_id, l.lead_id, rs.shop_config_id, v.sec_uid, (ifnull(v.has_comment, 0) * 1000 + least(ifnull(v.comment_count, 0), 100) * 10 + least(datediff(curdate(), ifnull(v.first_seen_date, curdate())), 365)) as priority, row_number() over ( partition by l.viewer_id, rs.shop_config_id order by l.lead_date desc, l.lead_id desc ) as rn from dy_viewer_daily_lead l inner join dy_viewer v on v.viewer_id = l.viewer_id inner join dy_rpa_room_shop rs on rs.room_key = l.room_key inner join dy_rpa_shop_config sc on sc.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id and sc.status = '0' where v.sec_uid is not null and trim(v.sec_uid) != '' and ifnull(v.status, 'new') = 'new' and (v.last_seen_date is null or v.last_seen_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 30 day)) ) ranked where ranked.rn = 1 order by ranked.priority desc, ranked.lead_id asc limit 1000

insert ignore into dy_rpa_outreach_batch( batch_no, shop_config_id, active_shop_key, worker_id, lease_token, status, task_count, completed_count, lease_expire_time, create_time, update_time ) values( #{batchNo}, #{shopConfigId}, cast(#{shopConfigId} as char), #{workerId}, #{leaseToken}, 'leased', 0, 0, date_add(sysdate(), interval #{leaseMinutes} minute), sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.select: select task_id from dy_rpa_outreach_task where shop_config_id = #{shopConfigId} and status = 'pending' and attempt_count < max_attempts order by priority desc, task_id asc limit #{limit} for update skip locked

select b.batch_id as batchId, b.batch_no as batchNo, b.shop_config_id as shopConfigId, b.worker_id as workerId, b.lease_token as leaseToken, b.status, b.task_count as taskCount, b.completed_count as completedCount, b.lease_expire_time as leaseExpiresAt, b.create_time as createTime, sc.shop_code as shopCode, sc.shop_name as shopName, sc.douyin_account_code as douyinAccountCode, sc.douyin_shop_name as douyinShopName, sc.message_template as messageTemplate, sc.daily_limit as dailyLimit from dy_rpa_outreach_batch b inner join dy_rpa_shop_config sc on sc.shop_config_id = b.shop_config_id where b.batch_no = #{batchNo} limit 1

select t.task_id as taskId, t.task_no as taskNo, t.lead_id as leadId, t.viewer_id as viewerId, t.sec_uid as secUid, t.profile_url as profileUrl, t.status, t.priority, t.attempt_count as attemptCount, v.nickname, ifnull(v.has_comment, 0) as hasComment, ifnull(v.comment_count, 0) as commentCount, v.last_comment_content as lastCommentContent, ( select ifnull(sum(s.estimated_stay_seconds), 0) from dy_live_viewer_stay s where s.viewer_id = t.viewer_id and s.room_key = l.room_key and s.last_seen_at >= l.lead_date and s.first_seen_at < date_add(l.lead_date, interval 1 day) ) as estimatedStaySeconds, l.lead_date as leadDate, coalesce(nullif(r.room_name, ''), nullif(l.live_room_name, ''), l.room_key) as liveRoomName from dy_rpa_outreach_task t inner join dy_viewer v on v.viewer_id = t.viewer_id inner join dy_viewer_daily_lead l on l.lead_id = t.lead_id left join dy_live_room r on r.room_key = l.room_key where t.batch_no = #{batchNo} and t.status = 'leased' order by t.priority desc, t.task_id asc

select task_id as taskId, task_no as taskNo, viewer_id as viewerId, lead_id as leadId, shop_config_id as shopConfigId, status, attempt_count as attemptCount, max_attempts as maxAttempts, batch_no as batchNo, lease_token as leaseToken, worker_id as workerId, lease_expire_time as leaseExpiresAt, result_request_id as resultRequestId, outcome from dy_rpa_outreach_task where task_no = #{taskNo} limit 1 for update

select task_no as taskNo, status, outcome, order_no as orderNo, completed_time as completedTime, result_request_id as requestId from dy_rpa_outreach_task where result_request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.update: update dy_rpa_outreach_task set status = #{status}, result_request_id = #{requestId}, outcome = #{outcome}, douyin_no = nullif(#{douyinNo}, ''), order_no = nullif(#{orderNo}, ''), followed = #{followed}, messaged = #{messaged}, message_content = nullif(#{messageContent}, ''), result_code = nullif(#{resultCode}, ''), error_message = nullif(#{errorMessage}, ''), lease_token = null, worker_id = null, lease_expire_time = null, completed_time = nullsysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'leased'

update dy_rpa_outreach_batch b set completed_count = ( select count(1) from dy_rpa_outreach_task t where t.batch_no = b.batch_no and t.status != 'leased' ), status = if( exists(select 1 from dy_rpa_outreach_task t where t.batch_no = b.batch_no and t.status = 'leased'), 'leased', 'completed' ), active_shop_key = if( exists(select 1 from dy_rpa_outreach_task t where t.batch_no = b.batch_no and t.status = 'leased'), b.active_shop_key, null ), completed_time = if( exists(select 1 from dy_rpa_outreach_task t where t.batch_no = b.batch_no and t.status = 'leased'), null, sysdate() ), update_time = sysdate() where b.batch_no = #{batchNo} and b.status = 'leased'

update dy_viewer v inner join dy_viewer_daily_lead l on l.viewer_id = v.viewer_id and l.lead_id = #{leadId} set v.status = 'pre_ordered', v.order_no = #{orderNo}, v.remark = concat_ws('；', nullif(v.remark, ''), #{remark}), v.manual_update_time = sysdate(), v.update_time = sysdate(), l.status = 'pre_ordered', l.order_no = #{orderNo}, l.remark = concat_ws('；', nullif(l.remark, ''), #{remark}), l.manual_update_time = sysdate(), l.update_time = sysdate()

update dy_viewer v inner join dy_viewer_daily_lead l on l.viewer_id = v.viewer_id and l.lead_id = #{leadId} set v.status = 'following', v.last_follow_time = sysdate(), v.manual_update_time = sysdate(), v.update_time = sysdate(), l.status = 'following', l.last_follow_time = sysdate(), l.manual_update_time = sysdate(), l.update_time = sysdate()
mapper.insert: insert into dy_viewer_follow_record( lead_id, viewer_id, follow_content, follow_result, next_follow_time, operator_id, operator_name, create_time ) values( #{leadId}, #{viewerId}, #{followContent}, #{followResult}, null, null, #{workerId}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update dy_rpa_outreach_task set status = if(attempt_count >= max_attempts, 'failed', 'pending'), lease_token = null, worker_id = null, lease_expire_time = null, result_code = if(attempt_count >= max_attempts, 'RELEASE_EXHAUSTED', result_code), error_message = if(attempt_count >= max_attempts, '任务释放次数过多', error_message), completed_time = if(attempt_count >= max_attempts, sysdate(), null), update_time = sysdate() where batch_no = #{batchNo} and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and worker_id = #{workerId} and status = 'leased'
mapper.select: select sc.shop_config_id as shopConfigId, sc.shop_code as shopCode, sc.shop_name as shopName, sc.douyin_account_code as douyinAccountCode, sc.douyin_shop_name as douyinShopName, sc.message_template as messageTemplate, sc.daily_limit as dailyLimit, sc.status, sc.remark, sc.create_time as createTime, sc.update_time as updateTime, group_concat(rs.room_key order by rs.room_key separator '、') as roomKeys, count(rs.room_key) as roomCount from dy_rpa_shop_config sc left join dy_rpa_room_shop rs on rs.shop_config_id = sc.shop_config_id group by sc.shop_config_id order by sc.status asc, sc.shop_config_id asc

select r.room_key as roomKey, r.room_name as roomName, r.last_report_time as lastReportTime from dy_live_room r left join dy_rpa_room_shop rs on rs.room_key = r.room_key where rs.room_key is null order by r.last_report_time desc, r.room_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into dy_rpa_shop_config( shop_code, shop_name, douyin_account_code, douyin_shop_name, message_template, daily_limit, status, remark, create_time, update_time ) values( #{shopCode}, #{shopName}, #{douyinAccountCode}, #{douyinShopName}, #{messageTemplate}, #{dailyLimit}, #{status}, #{remark}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update dy_rpa_shop_config set shop_code = #{shopCode}, shop_name = #{shopName}, douyin_account_code = #{douyinAccountCode}, douyin_shop_name = #{douyinShopName}, message_template = #{messageTemplate}, daily_limit = #{dailyLimit}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = sysdate() where shop_config_id = #{shopConfigId}
mapper.select: select shop_config_id as shopConfigId, shop_code as shopCode, shop_name as shopName, douyin_account_code as douyinAccountCode, douyin_shop_name as douyinShopName, message_template as messageTemplate, daily_limit as dailyLimit, status, remark from dy_rpa_shop_config where shop_config_id = #{shopConfigId} limit 1
mapper.insert:
insert into dy_rpa_room_shop(room_key, shop_config_id, create_time, update_time) values
(#{roomKey}, #{shopConfigId}, sysdate(), sysdate())
on duplicate key update shop_config_id = values(shop_config_id), update_time = sysdate()
